Anya M.: Heads-up — AtlasPay execs asked for a 10-min preview during their EBR next week. They want a clear concession grid (if any), a short risk/mitigation snapshot, and a single-slide demo. Can we compress to a 6-slide deck? Link: gs://redwood/qbrs/atlaspay-preview-2026.pptx

Ben R.: Ill own the concession grid. Need: current discount tiers, any prior concessions, and a simple ARR impact calc. @Liam K. can you drop ARR_at_risk and the renewal timing?

Sofia L.: Ill do onboarding + churn signals. Quick ask: include latest activation funnel and 7/30/90-day retention. I noticed a spike in support tickets tied to webhooks last week ":bug:"  should we call that out?

Priya R.: Yes call it out as a short bullet under blockers. Also legal flagged a data residency clause in the SOW; need confirmation if AtlasPay required Private deployment. Ill follow up with legal and post an update here.

Liam K.: Renewal window closes 2026-03-15. ARR at risk estimate: $420k (preliminary). Ill add two mitigation paths: targeted enablement + short-term discount. Posting the ARR calc to the deck assets folder now.

DevOps-bot: Staging environment reserved: staging-42 booked Thu 2026-02-12 08:3010:00 PT for demo rehearsals.
